products.product_description: Coast Tropical Brand Whole Mangoes, Kent & Keitt's varieties, 10 lb box. The recalled mangos were sold between July 7, and August 30, 2012 and can be identified by the brand sticker along with one of the following numbers: 3114, 4051, 4311, 4584, and 4959 and the words PRODUCT OF MEXICO. Packed in carboard open carton tray.
products.code_info: The recalled mangos were sold between July 7, and August 30, 2012 and can be identified by the brand sticker along with one of the following numbers: 3114, 4051, 4311, 4584, and 4959 and the words PRODUCT OF MEXICO.
products.reason_for_recall: The mangoes, packed at Agricola Daniella, in Sinaloa, Mexico, that have the potential to be contaminated with Salmonella Branderup.
